description: Append the two independent rank pan lanes to the original eighteen modern VST3 sample-accurate lanes. The original host-automation.json contract and all its numeric tolerances remain unchanged.

host_automation_pan.keys: Original eighteen in original order, followed by rank 1 CP_pan and rank 2 CP_pan.
host_automation_pan.authority: Rank pan remains independent of PANEL, factory tabs and MEMORY, matching existing readParameters source resolution; ordinary preset recall still recalls pan. Other selected programmer controls remain protected.
host_automation_pan.timing: Modern VST3 normalized piecewise-linear sample offsets. Legacy/PURE retain final-point-at-block-start, no queue remains unchanged, AU remains block-rate. Existing interpolation/audio thresholds apply without relaxation.
host_automation_pan.verification: Actual built VST3 module, each rank separately, selected source controls, finite nonzero stereo response, scalar and partition references, both instruments, zero-frame and program boundaries. No physical DAW or perceptual listening qualification.
